one_liner: Instead of a life, the game pays $1 of real money to the player's PayPal.
author: aadi

change.title: Existing opportunity: Out of lives? $1 to your PayPal for a short game
change.offer_copy: Out of lives? Play a short game and get $1 sent to your PayPal.

reward.unit: US dollars paid to the player's PayPal

change.ad_fail_path: If no game is ready, the button is hidden. If the game doesn't count, no money is sent and the try isn't used.

flow_steps.caption: The player taps Play on a level with 0 lives.
The out-of-lives pop-up shows the new button under the gold-bar button.
The player plays a short game and can close it at any time.
A note says $1 is on its way to the player's PayPal; lives come back on the usual timer.

change.after_reward: Lives come back every 30 minutes as today, and the button offers another $1, up to 3 a day.
change.rationale: Running out of lives is the moment a player stops. A dollar for a short game gives them a reason to stay, without touching the gold-bar sale for lives.
